messages:
incidentbot: PagerDuty: page fired for svc-embedder-eu — HIGH error-rate (P1). Trigger: 5xx rate > 5% for 3m. Incident INC-2026-045. Link: https://pd/redwood/incidents/INC-2026-045
aj: saw the PD, grabbing it now
miguel: i'm on-call and will ack in PD
devon: acked and assigned to miguel :white_check_mark:
miguel: quick triage — embeddings queue in EU cluster showing sustained 5xx from embedder replicas. error sample: `2026-03-17T10:12:03Z embedder: downstream 500 on chunkify`
sarah: customer impact? any complete outages?
miguel: partial impact — approx 12% of embedding requests for a subset of EU customers failing (~8k reqs/min). Some customers see higher latency + errors, not fully down.
devon: mitigation plan: 1) scale eu embedder pool +2 replicas 2) route eu-critical customers to us-west fallback 3) enable degraded retry/backoff for non-critical traffic. starting step 1 now.
miguel: scaling with: `kubectl scale deployment/embedder-eu --replicas=6 -n inference` -> rollout initiated
oncall-bot: deployment/embedder-eu scaled to 6 (new pods scheduling) — watch: new pods expected healthy in ~30s
miguel: error rate dropping to ~3.4% after new pods, but still seeing intermittent 500s ~1m window. will flip routing for critical customers next. devon can do the route change?
devon: applying route patch for group `eu-critical` -> us-west fallback. patch: `api PATCH /routes/eu-critical {fallback: "us-west"}` -> applied, verifying
sarah: pinging AE to notify ACME and other affected customers (cc @support)
support: ACME reports they saw a spike in failed embeddings 5–10m ago, they appreciate the heads-up
miguel: metrics now showing error-rate ~1.2% and latency improving. keeping PD open for 30m observation. if it stays <2% we close.
devon: adding post-incident checklist link: https://docs/redwood/incidents/INC-2026-045-checklist
miguel: will hand off monitoring to night oncall at 0300 UTC — assigning to nina for observation and escalation if needed
nina: acknowledged, i'll monitor dashboards and alerts overnight, will escalate if it resurfaces
incidentbot: PagerDuty: incident INC-2026-045 reassigned to nina (oncall) at 1769999180
